我的价值
以专业为基础，参与真实的企业与项目。
我的法律背景让我能够更早识别合同、合规和监管问题，但我希望参与的不只是法律事项本身。对企业服务和跨境项目而言，我更希望把研究、沟通、资源连接和项目跟进结合起来，在需要专业判断时知道应当进一步确认什么，在日常项目中也能够承担具体而实际的工作。
01 · 法律意识与前期支持
让法律意识从项目一开始就参与，而不是等问题出现以后再介入。
作为园区内部具有法律训练的团队成员，我可以持续跟进企业和项目，在不同阶段提供及时、连续、贴近业务的前期法律与监管支持。
前期识别
在企业落地、合作及项目推进过程中，协助识别可能涉及的法律与监管问题。
公司设立 · 用工 · 合同 · 知识产权 · 数据 · 市场准入
例如一家中国科技企业准备进入比利时，可以从一开始就关注：
公司如何落地？员工如何来比利时？技术和知识产权如何保护？产品进入欧洲是否涉及监管要求？
研究与核实
针对具体问题检索中国、比利时及欧盟的官方信息，梳理基本规则、政策背景及需要进一步确认的事项。
官方来源 → 信息核实 → 提炼重点 → 明确问题
文件与合同支持
协助阅读和整理企业及项目中的合同、合作文件和相关材料，从法律训练的角度识别值得重点关注或进一步确认的问题。
责任 · 终止 · 知识产权归属 · 保密 · 数据 · 法律适用
及时响应 · 全程跟进
贴近项目意味着理解其背景，而不只是回应一个孤立的问题。
企业临时提出问题、项目会议出现新的法律事项、专业机构需要补充材料，或管理层需要快速了解一项政策时，可以及时介入：
了解背景 → 查找信息 → 梳理问题 → 反馈进展 → 跟进下一步
从企业第一次提出问题，到资料准备、专业咨询、会议沟通及后续行动，保持信息和项目的连续性。
前置介入 · 及时响应 · 全程跟随
查看具体应用场景
网页默认折叠
企业落地
公司设立、工作许可、用工及基础监管问题的前期信息支持。
技术与研发合作
关注知识产权、技术许可、保密及研发成果归属等事项。
商业合作与交易
识别合作文件、交易谈判和项目推进中的合同及监管事项。
知识产权
关注商标、专利、技术许可、保密及商业化中的知识产权问题。
政策与法规
协助研究当地政策、欧洲法律法规、投资及研发激励等官方信息。
商业风险信息
协助核实公开信息、整理合作方资料，并识别需要进一步专业核查的事项。
02 · 中欧专业资源连接与转译
听得懂专业语言，也能把专业语言讲清楚。
当问题需要律师、商会、会计师或其他专业团队进一步处理时，我可以协助承担园区、企业与专业资源之间的沟通接口，帮助整理、理解和转译专业信息。
把问题整理清楚
先理解企业和项目背景，整理相关事实与材料，把较为宽泛的业务需求转化成专业团队能够快速理解和回应的具体问题。
了解项目背景 → 整理事实与文件 → 拆分具体问题 → 明确需要专业确认的事项
把两边准确连接起来
中国法学本科与国际商法硕士训练，使我能够理解专业术语、法律逻辑和不同法律环境下的表达方式，减少信息传递中的理解偏差，从而更有效地协助国内外专业团队之间的沟通。
中国 ↔ 欧洲
“走出去” · “引进来”
既可以协助中国企业连接欧洲专业资源，也可以在欧洲企业或机构与中国开展合作时，利用中国法律体系基础协助沟通与专业资源衔接。
转译并持续跟进
专业意见往往需要转化为业务团队能够快速理解和使用的内容。
将复杂、篇幅较长的法律或监管信息提炼成园区管理层和企业更容易使用的内容：
这意味着什么？
重点是什么？
还需要确认什么？
下一步做什么？
并继续跟进材料补充、信息反馈、行动项及后续沟通，让专业意见真正回到企业和项目中。
专业意见 → 园区与企业理解 → 下一步行动
查看法律桥梁如何运作
网页默认折叠
企业
提出实际业务需求：
“这个合同能不能签？”
“中国员工怎么来比利时？”
“这个技术合作需要注意什么？”

03 · 综合项目与团队支持
快速理解，灵活协作，在项目需要的地方发挥作用。
除了法律相关工作，我也可以作为综合型团队成员参与园区的企业服务、中欧项目及日常业务支持。面对新的任务，我能够较快理解背景、梳理信息，并在沟通、协调和执行中持续跟进。
跨境项目支持
参与中欧科创、产学研及技术合作项目的背景研究、资料准备、多方沟通、会议协调、行动项整理及进度跟进，帮助项目中的信息和任务持续向前推进。
企业服务
协助了解和记录企业需求，参与企业走访、日常沟通及后续跟进，整理企业在落地和发展过程中提出的问题、材料与待办事项。
研究与管理支持
针对新的企业、政策、行业、合作机构或专项任务，开展背景调查、资料检索与信息整理，形成简洁的 briefing、政策摘要、问题清单或会议材料，为团队和管理层提供信息支持。
商务沟通与活动支持
协助企业及代表团来访、合作机构联络、论坛与商务沙龙、会议及参访活动，参与前期沟通、双语材料准备、嘉宾联络、会务协调及现场支持。
我也在积极学习和提升法语，希望随着语言能力的提高，逐步参与更多与比利时本地机构、合作伙伴和企业的直接沟通。
灵活补位
我愿意灵活参与不同类型的工作，面对不熟悉的任务也能快速学习，并在团队需要的时候承担具体支持。
快速理解 · 清晰梳理 · 有效协调 · 持续推进
04 · 文化、活动与一点额外的可能
专业之外，我也愿意给团队带来一点创意和活力。
音乐、舞台和学生艺术团队经历一直是我个人背景中很重要的一部分。如果园区有企业活动、代表团交流或中欧文化项目，我也很乐意把这一面的经验带进工作中。
活动与节目
在园区年会、企业活动、论坛晚宴或文化交流活动中，可以参与节目创意、流程设计、演出准备及现场支持。
中欧文化交流
在代表团来访、中欧交流或国际社区活动中，可以协助设计和组织更有文化互动感和参与感的环节，让商务交流之外多一点人与人之间的连接。
舞台与表演
凭借声乐、小提琴及舞台演出经历，在合适的场合也可以直接参与演唱、音乐表演或节目呈现。
也可以在幕后
过去的合唱团管理经历让我不仅熟悉舞台，也熟悉舞台背后的人员协调、排练组织、节目衔接和现场配合。需要的时候，既可以站在台前，也可以在幕后把事情组织好。
音乐 · 舞台 · 活动 · 文化交流 · 创意

03 What I Bring | English
Professional Foundations, Practical Support.
My legal background helps me identify contractual, compliance and regulatory issues at an earlier stage, but I hope to contribute beyond legal matters alone. In enterprise services and cross-border projects, I would like to combine research, communication, resource connections and project follow-up, knowing what needs further confirmation when professional judgment is required, while also taking on concrete, practical work in everyday projects.
01 · LEGAL AWARENESS & EARLY SUPPORT
Bring legal awareness into a project from the outset, rather than waiting until problems arise.
As a team member with legal training, I can stay close to companies and projects throughout their development, providing responsive early-stage legal and regulatory support when questions arise.
SPOT EARLY
Identify potential legal and regulatory issues during company establishment, business cooperation and project development.
Company Setup · Employment · Contracts · IP · Data · Market Access
For example, when a Chinese technology company plans to enter Belgium:
How should the company establish its local presence? How will employees work locally? How should technology and IP be protected? Are there regulatory requirements for entering the European market?
RESEARCH & CHECK
Research relevant Chinese, Belgian and EU official information, clarify the basic regulatory framework and identify matters requiring further confirmation.
Official Sources → Verify → Extract → Clarify
DOCUMENT & CONTRACT SUPPORT
Assist with reviewing and organising contracts, cooperation documents and project materials, identifying clauses or issues that deserve closer attention or further professional confirmation.
Liability · Termination · IP Ownership · Confidentiality · Data · Governing Law
RESPOND & FOLLOW
Being close to the project means understanding its context, not simply responding to an isolated question.
[New translation] I can step in promptly when a company raises an unexpected question, a new legal matter comes up in a project meeting, a professional adviser needs additional materials, or management needs a quick understanding of a policy:
Understand → Research → Organise → Respond → Follow Up
From the first question to document preparation, professional consultation and subsequent action, I can help maintain continuity throughout the process.
Early · Responsive · Continuous
＋ Explore Where I Can Support

Company Landing
Company establishment, work permits, employment and basic regulatory information.
Technology & R&D
IP ownership, licensing, confidentiality and research outcomes.
Business Cooperation
Contracts and regulatory issues arising from cooperation and transactions.
Intellectual Property
IP considerations in European market entry, technology cooperation and commercialisation.
Policy & Regulation
Research relevant policies, regulations, investment and R&D incentives.
Business Risk Information
Support public-information checks and identify matters requiring further professional verification.
02 · CHINA–EUROPE PROFESSIONAL INTERFACE
Understand professional language — and make it understandable.
When a matter requires further support from lawyers, chambers of commerce, accountants or other specialists, I can help serve as a communication interface between CBTC, companies and professional resources.
BEFORE
Understand the business context, organise relevant facts and documents, and turn broad business concerns into clear questions for professional advisers.
Understand the context → Organise facts and documents → Identify the issue → Formulate clear questions
DURING
My academic foundation in Chinese law and International Commercial Law helps me understand legal concepts, contractual logic and cross-border commercial issues, supporting more effective communication with Chinese and European professional teams.
China ↔ Europe
 “Going out” · “Bringing in”
I can help Chinese companies connect with professional resources in Europe, and draw on my foundation in the Chinese legal system to support communication and connections with professional resources when European companies or institutions work with China.
AFTER
Professional advice often needs to be translated into something the business team can quickly understand and use.
Distil complex and lengthy legal or regulatory information into content that CBTC management and companies can use more easily:
What does it mean?
What matters?
What needs attention?
What happens next?
Continue following up on additional materials, feedback, action points and subsequent communication, so that professional advice is brought back into the work of the company and the project.
Professional Advice → Business Understanding → Next Step

03 · CROSS-FUNCTIONAL SUPPORT
Ready to learn, adapt and contribute wherever the project needs support.
Beyond legal-related work, I can contribute as a flexible team member across enterprise services, China–Europe projects and everyday team needs — understanding new tasks quickly, organising information clearly and following matters through. 
Research · Projects · Communication · Coordination · Execution
Cross-border Project Support
Support China–Europe innovation, industry–academia collaboration and technology projects through background research, document preparation, multi-party communication, meeting coordination, action-point organisation and progress follow-up.
Enterprise Services
Support company visits, everyday communication and follow-up, helping organise enterprise needs, materials, questions and next steps during market entry and development.
Research & Management Support
Conduct background research, information retrieval and structured analysis on new companies, policies, industries, partner organisations or specific assignments, producing concise briefings, policy summaries, question lists or meeting materials.
Business Communication & Events
Support company and delegation visits, partner communication, forums, business networking events, meetings and study visits, including early-stage liaison, bilingual materials, guest coordination and on-site support.
I am also actively improving my French, with the aim of gradually taking on more direct communication with Belgian institutions, partners and local companies.
Flexible Execution
I am comfortable working across functions, learning unfamiliar tasks quickly and stepping in where the team needs practical support.
Understand quickly · Organise clearly · Coordinate effectively · Follow through
04 · CULTURE & EVENTS
Beyond professional work, I can bring a little creativity and energy to the team.
Music, stage performance and student arts leadership have long been an important part of my background. When appropriate, I would be happy to bring this experience into company events, delegation programmes and China–Europe cultural exchange.
Events & Programmes
Contribute to programme ideas, event flow, performance preparation and on-site support for company events, annual gatherings, forums, dinners or cultural programmes.
Cultural Exchange
Support cultural and interactive elements in delegation visits, China–Europe exchange programmes and international community activities, adding another dimension to professional exchange.
Stage & Performance
With experience in singing, violin and stage performance, I can also contribute directly to music, singing or programme presentation when appropriate.
Behind the Scenes
My previous choir leadership experience also gave me practical exposure to people coordination, rehearsal organisation, programme transitions and on-site teamwork.
Music · Stage · Events · Cultural Exchange · Creativity
